body:
Dylan Brooks: Heads up: we’re opening the **internal beta** for **Optimize config version history + one-click rollback** in Console. This is the first deliverable in the “Safe apply + rollback mechanism” work.

What’s included in beta (v1):
- Version history per scope (route/model/customer env) with immutable versions + metadata
- Compare view (diff/preview)
- One-click rollback to a prior version (whole-config rollback)
- Audit events emitted for apply/rollback attempts + outcomes

What’s *not* included yet:
- Safe-apply preflight + canary gates (coming next)
- Automated rollback (still human-driven)
- Partial rollback of single fields

How to get access:
1) Request the RBAC role **Optimize Config Operator (beta)** via #help-internal-support or INT ticket template: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/INT-911
   - Note: rollback permission is restricted; SRE on-call + approved operators only.
2) Ask to be added to feature flag: `console.optimize_config_history_rollbacks_beta` (include your env: staging/prod-internal)
3) Docs + quickstart are here (WIP): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ENG/Optimize+Config+History+%2B+Rollback

Where to file bugs/feedback:
- Linear project: **Safe apply + rollback** (tag `optimize-config-rollback`)
- Use the bug template issue and include **scope** + **version_id** + **correlation_id** if you have it: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4826
- If something is urgent / production-impacting in internal envs, ping #eng-sre and drop the rollback link.

Known sharp edges in this beta:
- Rollback triggers cache invalidation + warmup; expect a brief token throughput dip.
- If you have an in-flight apply, rollback will be blocked until the lease expires (to avoid split-brain).
- Dedicated/Private tenants are not enabled yet (Hosted internal only).

Thanks to Chloe / Hannah / Benji / Mateo / SRE folks who helped get this to a usable first cut. Please try it on staging, try to break it, and tell us what’s confusing.

Marissa Cole: Adding a UX note: if you’re testing, please include a “reason” and link a ticket in the change metadata. We want to validate the audit trail end-to-end (who/what/why) before we open to more teams.

Chloe Martin: If anyone hits a weird diff rendering (nested configs, arrays), please attach the config blob (redact customer identifiers) + screenshot. The compare view is still iterating.

Connor O'Brien: Release detail: this is behind the flag Dylan mentioned + control-plane flag `optimize.config_versioning.enabled` in internal clusters. If you’re testing in `staging-usw2`, you should be good; if you’re in `staging-euc1`, ping me.

Rafael Mendes: SRE ask: if you use rollback during a test incident, please post in #eng-oncall with:
- what you changed
- time to rollback
- which dashboards you used to confirm recovery
We’re trying to baseline MTTR and refine the runbook.

Fiona McCarthy: Security/compliance reminder: audit events are immutable + retained. Don’t put secrets in the “reason” field. Use ticket links, not pasted credentials/log dumps.

Allison Grant: Metrics are live in the new dashboard panels (internal only): https://grafana.redwoodinference.com/d/optimize-config-change-health
If you see `config_apply_failed` spikes, include the `correlation_id` in your Linear report.

Devon Price: incident-bot now posts rollback deep links for internal beta scopes. If you want it enabled in your team channel, DM me the channel + which env.

Kenji Nakamura: If you have 10 min, I’d love quick feedback on the confirmation copy / blast radius display. Reply here w/ “confusing” screenshots and I’ll fold it into the next iteration.

incident-bot: FYI: internal beta enabled for cluster `staging-usw2` (flag `console.optimize_config_history_rollbacks_beta=true`). For issues, file under Linear label `optimize-config-rollback`.
